objective: Execute GCL-06 — Complication, Escalation, Reversal & Twist Library. Build controlled complication families from color/inconvenience through crisis, with compatibility, opportunity-bearing alternatives and derailment-recovery structures that preserve player agency.

acceptance_profile.breadth: At least 100 approved-library complications/escalations; target 340 across 17 controlled families, 20 each.
acceptance_profile.severity: Cover color, inconvenience, pressure, setback and crisis without treating severity as a universal difficulty score.
acceptance_profile.agency: Every record preserves multiple responses and continuations and forbids mandatory choices or forced outcomes.
acceptance_profile.recovery: Every record includes derailment-recovery prompts; dedicated recovery family treats unexpected player choices as valid input.
acceptance_profile.opportunity: Every record includes at least one opportunity opening so complications are not purely punitive.
acceptance_profile.information: Reveals/reversals use authorized evidence or explicitly unresolved unknowns only.
acceptance_profile.difficulty: Pressure references are descriptive only; GCL-07 owns difficulty shaping.
acceptance_profile.validation: Repository health checks exact count/family/severity/form breadth, archive digest, stable IDs, slots/placeholders, minimum trigger/escalation/reversal/response/continuation/recovery/opportunity surfaces, pressure vocabulary, proof target, discovery coverage and authority boundaries.

nonauthorization: forced player choice or required solution
next_action: Build, validate, merge and close GCL-06; then make GCL-07 ready_to_start because GCL-04/05/06 dependencies are satisfied while GCL-13 remains independently ready.
